front.title: Continuity and Accountability Observations for Agentic Systems

abstract.t: Agentic systems change models, prompts, memory, policies, tools, and execution environments across handoffs. This document proposes an observation profile for recording those transitions and their evidence. It separates state, memory, policy, authority, and lineage discontinuities, distinguishes manual or simulated observations from attested executions, and defines coverage and missingness reporting. It also describes evaluation designs for continuity and bounded governance. Continuity records do not grant authority, establish clinical pathology or subjective experience, or validate an uncalibrated composite score.
